trends.details: Halloween-night outfit reels lead on October 31: flat-lay costume guides (Alice, Lalaloopsy, Princess, Hungry Caterpillar, Unicorn, Calico Critter, Precious Moments), Halloween-print cardigans, pumpkin-print vests and striped sweaters worn with mini skirts, tights and knee-high boots, plus horror-nights looks in haunted-house prints and fishnets. Underneath it all is the same layered fall base: trench coats, chunky knit sweaters, wide-leg trousers, loafers and over-the-knee boots in beige, camel, brown and black.
trends.title: Halloween outfit inspo, built on layered fall staples

trends.details: Light sectional sofas, chunky knit blankets, lit fireplaces, chandeliers and candles set the cozy fall base. For Halloween night it gets fully spooked: pumpkin-shaped decor, ceramic ghosts and pumpkin candles on the mantel, dried botanicals, black bat cutouts, faux cobwebs draped over chandeliers, skeleton hands, mummy canisters and even a life-sized mummy figure folded into otherwise neutral, upscale rooms. Atmospheric night tours show the same rooms glowing with lamps and candlelight.
trends.title: Halloween-night living rooms: cozy fall base, fully spooked

trends.details: On Halloween day, transformation reels overtake everyday fall glam. A playful clown look is built on harlequin diamonds stamped above the brows and beneath the eyes, with winged liner, a black-dotted nose and an extended red smile. A theatrical horror look pairs a pale base and dramatic black smoky eyes with extra eyes painted on the cheeks and a third eye on the forehead. And for last-minute looks, creators keep it simple: dark winged liner, red lips, and thin vein- or crack-like lines across the cheeks and forehead for a demonic, undead effect.
trends.title: Last-minute Halloween makeup: clown, doll, and simple spooky looks
